'''Paul Strangio OUCH (BHBM Smack Down)''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Paul Strangio]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10237">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10237 OUCH (BHBM Smack Down)], DeckTech (Paul "The Emperor" Strangio, 6 September 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10237/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10237/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018125143/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10237/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''OUCH (BHBM Smack Down)'''
* '''Author:''' Paul "The Emperor" Strangio
* '''Published:''' September 6, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This deck is made to Win.

=== Strategy ===

Cards I Wish I Had Room For

Come Here You Big Coward Empire's New Order AT-AT Cannon Force Lightning x2 Vader's Lightsaber Secret Plans First Strike Broken Concentration Oppresive Enforcement Monnok The Circle Is Now Complete Spaceport Docking Bay Lateral Damage Imperial Decree Control Twi-lek Adviser Dark Jedi Presence x2

I like this deck a lot...and I hope you do, too.  Please give constructive reviews of this deck so that I can make it even better.  Thanks a ton guys (and gals).

-Paul "The Emperor"
